Other NoSQL models and eventual consistency

NoSQL also includes key-value, wide-column and graph stores; eventual consistency means replicas
converge if updates stop under the model's assumptions.
හැම NoSQL database එකම document database එකක් JනාJවයි. Key-value cache එකකට, graph
relationships වලට, wide-column high-scale access patterns වලට භාවිත Jවන්න පුළුවන්. Eventual
consistency කියන්Jන් updates නවතින විට replicas converge වීමයි.
Use a cache for sessions, documents for products and a graph for relationships.

Interview question: Is NoSQL synonymous with eventual consistency?
Answer: No. Consistency depends on the particular system and configuration.

Remember: NoSQL is a family of models.
